address: 120-K1 Giang Vo Street, O Cho Dua Ward, Dong Da District, Hanoi, 11511, Vietnam
bio: One of four branches in the city, this bouncy family-run operation offers slick service. The homely vibe is depicted by chequered tablecloths, patterned wallpaper and brightly painted murals. Chả cá, grilled catfish seasoned with turmeric, is the name of the game here, although you can add nem cá, fish spring rolls, canh cá, fish soup, and lòng cá, fish stomach, as extras. The fresh, tasty food delivers an explosion of flavours and textures....
